pool.text: Muhammad Quli Qutb Shah established Hyderabad to extend the capital beyond Golconda.
The city was annexed by the Mughals during this year.
Asaf Jah I declared sovereignty and founded the Asaf Jahi dynasty.
Hyderabad city became the formal capital of the Asaf Jahi Nizams.
Mah Laqa Bai's Urdu Ghazal poetry collection Gulzar-e-Mahlaqa was published in Hyderabad.
The oldest police commissionerate in India was established in Hyderabad.
Deccan Radio started as the city's first radio public broadcast station in February.
Hyderabad was annexed by the Indian Union during this year.
Hyderabad was made the capital of the newly formed Andhra Pradesh.
Indian Drugs and Pharmaceuticals Limited was established as a public sector undertaking.
Television broadcasting began with the launch of Doordarshan public service broadcaster.
Private satellite channels started with the launch of Star TV in July.
The first public internet access service began operations in the city.
The first private sector internet service provider started operations in the city.
FM broadcasting began in Hyderabad alongside Deccan Radio's history.
Guinness World Records declared Ramoji Film City to be the world's largest film studio.
The HMWSSB started operating a long water supply pipeline from Nagarjuna Sagar Dam.
Deccani film industry films gained regional popularity starting around this year.
The GHMC was formed by merging the Municipal Corporation of Hyderabad with municipalities.
Archaeologists excavating near the city unearthed Iron Age sites dating back.
